evidence.observation: Pressure 2.903 Torr at growth start, matching the steady ~2.90 Torr seen during the ramp at 100 sccm
Pressure rose steadily to 3.184 Torr (about +0.07 Torr every 120 s) with no setpoint change
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not caused by the MFC
Thermocouple back at the 750 °C setpoint after a +10 °C overshoot at 2520 s; heater power drifting up from 39% to 45.5%
Sensor not installed; the atmosphere cannot be checked, which the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: Something that separates air leaking in from a restricted exhaust: an exhaust O2 or residual-gas reading, a rate-of-rise leak check with the tube isolated, or a check of the exhaust valve and pump line conductance. Characterization of the sample is also not available yet.
